name: gradient-cheerful-caramel
title: Cheerful Caramel
blurb: Linear gradient with cheerful caramel color transition.
description: A CSS-based cheerful caramel gradient component. Renders as a rounded rectangle with a linear background gradient.
use_when: Backgrounds, cards, or decorative sections needing a subtle color gradient.
avoid_when: When you need animated gradients; this component renders static CSS.
a11y: Purely decorative gradient container. No interactive elements.
